from arc_dsl import *

def transform(grid):
    g=[list(r) for r in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=mostcolor(tuple(map(tuple,grid)))
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]!=bg]
    if not pts: return grid
    r0=min(i for i,j in pts); r1=max(i for i,j in pts)
    c0=min(j for i,j in pts); c1=max(j for i,j in pts)
    F=3
    def edge(cells):  # cells: list of (i,j) on one edge with point color
        cells=sorted(cells)
        for a,b in zip(cells,cells[1:]):
            if a[0]==b[0]:
                for j in range(a[1]+1,b[1]): g[a[0]][j]=F
            elif a[1]==b[1]:
                for i in range(a[0]+1,b[0]): g[i][a[1]]=F
    top=[(i,j) for i,j in pts if i==r0]
    bot=[(i,j) for i,j in pts if i==r1]
    left=[(i,j) for i,j in pts if j==c0]
    right=[(i,j) for i,j in pts if j==c1]
    edge(top); edge(bot); edge(left); edge(right)
    return [list(r) for r in g]
